bandReport.notes: p00 is the INSTRUCTIONS COVER (T.B.C. CEBN-S-GKL, Test Booklet Series A, 120 items, Time Two Hours, Max Marks 100) — not transcribed. Content pages carry printed page numbers 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 for scan indices p01..p05, i.e. only the odd (English) leaves are in this scan; the Hindi versions are the even leaves and are visible here only as faint show-through, so nothing is missing. Layout is strictly two-column with a vertical rule; per page the LEFT column runs first and then the RIGHT: p01 = Q1-3 | Q4-6 (6 q); p02 = Q7-10 | Q11-13 (7 q); p03 = Q14-16 | Q17-20 (7 q); p04 = Q21-23 | Q24-26 (6 q); p05 = Q27-30 | Q31-34 (8 q). NO shared 'Directions:' code block anywhere in this band — every question prints its own four options directly beneath its own stem in its own column, and no option block spans a column or page break. Q1 (first on p01) is complete and starts the paper. Q34 (last, foot of the p05 right column) is complete: all four options print on p05 and nothing runs overleaf. Band-edge check on the neighbouring band: p06 opens Q35 (left column, 'statements about the Ajivikas') and Q38 (right column, 'bow (and arrow) as a weapon of war'), both complete from their own stems, so no question is shared across the B1/B2 boundary. Numbering is contiguous 1-34 with no gaps and no duplicates. NOTE for the merge: this paper has NO OCR text layer at all (get_text() returns empty for all 18 pages), so every string here was read off the page image; digit-sequence option sets (Q7, Q16) and all numeric options (Q23, Q24, Q27, Q28) were re-verified individually at 6-7x from the source PDF. Q27's decimals are printed with a raised middle dot (0·5 N) in UPSC house style and are transcribed with an ordinary full stop.
